name: Aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated lysosomal clearance of protein aggregates
rationale: All members concern routing misfolded or aggregated proteins to lysosomes (aggresome assembly, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and endosomal microautophagy, ataxin-3-type DUBs), unlike confusables centred on organelle-selective autophagy, ERAD or autophagosome maturation.

name: Hindbrain development with branchiomotor cranial nerve formation
rationale: Members cover brainstem/pons maturation, hindbrain neuron migration and brainstem-controlled functions (respiration, suckling), with facial/trigeminal branchiomotor nerve development distinguishing it from cerebellar, spinal-cord and cranial-ganglion confusables.

name: Adenylate cyclase–cAMP–PKA signalling with adrenergic receptor control
rationale: Members span cAMP synthesis, PDE breakdown, PKA/CREB/DARPP-32 effectors and their regulation, with alpha-2 adrenergic and epinephrine/norepinephrine control setting it apart from purinergic, cholinergic and smooth-muscle confusables.

name: p14ARF–p53–p21 axis and its cancer defects
rationale: Members concern TP53 expression, co-factors and p21-driven G1 arrest plus their loss through p14ARF or TP53 tetramerization defects, whereas confusables cover p16INK4A defects or p53 phosphorylation, degradation and DNA-repair targets.

name: Leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis, catabolism and receptor signalling
rationale: Members cover 5-lipoxygenase products (leukotrienes, lipoxins, 5-HETE), their omega-oxidation catabolism and transport, and leukotriene receptor signalling, which the broader eicosanoid and resolvin confusables lack.

name: Cytochrome P450 epoxygenase and omega-hydroxylase eicosanoid synthesis
rationale: All members describe P450 oxidation of arachidonate to EETs/DHETs and 20-HETE, distinguishing it from cyclooxygenase, leukotriene and general fatty-acid confusables.

name: Hypersensitivity and antibody-dependent cytotoxicity with endopeptidase regulation
rationale: Members concern type II/IV hypersensitivity, ADCC and acute inflammation to antigen, and uniquely include endopeptidase regulation, which the Fc-receptor, complement and neutrophil confusables lack.

qualifier: 3'-end processing including histone mRNAs, snRNP assembly
name: mRNA 3'-end processing, snRNP assembly and nuclear export
rationale: Members cover polyadenylation and histone stem-loop 3'-end processing, snRNP assembly and cap hypermethylation, and nuclear export of mature mRNAs, combining processing and export that the splicing, decay and snRNA-transcription confusables split.

name: Vesicle targeting and tethering to Golgi
rationale: All members (obsolete GO terms) describe vesicle targeting/tethering steps in ER–Golgi traffic, as opposed to the COPI/COPII coat budding and cargo-loading confusables.

name: Responses to pesticides, dioxin and endocrine-disrupting chemicals
rationale: Members are cellular responses to xenobiotic environmental chemicals (insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, TCDD, bisphenol A, genistein) with aryl hydrocarbon receptor signalling, unlike confusables about xenobiotic metabolism, metal ions or vitamins.

name: Sulfate-donor and nucleotide-sugar supply with hyaluronan degradation
rationale: Members concern PAPS synthesis/transport, sulfate and nucleotide-sugar transporters, UDP-glucuronate formation and sulfatase activation feeding glycosaminoglycan metabolism, plus hyaluronan degradation, unlike confusables on lysosomal GAG catabolism or GAG chain biosynthesis.

name: CDKN2A–p53 tumour suppression and its cancer-associated defects
rationale: Members span p53 expression, p21 G1 arrest and p53-driven apoptosis together with p14ARF and p16INK4A loss-of-function defects, whereas confusables cover senescence programmes, p53 apoptotic target genes or RB1/CDK4 G1/S control.

name: RUNX1 transcriptional control of haematopoietic and immune genes
rationale: All members concern RUNX-family (mainly RUNX1) regulation of myeloid, megakaryocyte, BCR and interleukin genes, distinct from granulopoiesis programmes and from RUNX1 targets outside blood (WNT, estrogen, keratinocyte).

qualifier: RNA polymerase I rRNA transcription under MYC control
name: rRNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis under MYC control
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA transcription and its chromatin regulation, rRNA processing, ribosome assembly/export and MYC target programmes, unlike confusables on Pol III transcription or translation initiation.

name: G protein coupling to cAMP and IP3–calcium second messengers
rationale: Members describe GPCR coupling to adenylate cyclase (cAMP synthesis) and phospholipase C/IP3-calcium production, lacking the PKA/PDE effectors and adrenergic inhibitory pathways of the confusables.

name: Phosphoinositide and serine-kinase signalling, including PAK-2p34 cell death
rationale: Members concern phosphatidylinositol signalling (nuclear PIPs, PTEN, AKT1 E17K, TORC2) and peptidyl-serine phosphorylation, with PAK-2p34 regulation distinguishing it from PTEN/AKT and inositol-pyrophosphate confusables.

name: Keratan sulfate metabolism and cartilage maintenance
rationale: Members cover keratan sulfate synthesis, degradation and related glycosylation defects plus cartilage development/homeostasis and chondrodysplasia transporters, unlike confusables on chondroitin/heparan sulfate or dystroglycan glycosylation.

name: Osteoblast–osteoclast regulation of bone remodelling and mineralization
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast and osteoclast proliferation/differentiation, bone resorption and mineralization via Wnt, TGF-beta and BMP signals in mesenchymal stroma, whereas confusables centre on ossification, chondrocyte and skeletal morphogenesis.

name: Appetite and feeding behaviour regulation by nutrient status
rationale: Members concern eating behaviour, appetite and responses to nutrient levels (leptin, ghrelin, sucrose, dietary excess), unlike confusables on growth, peptide-hormone receptors or orexin sleep regulation.

qualifier: intestinal and renal, with transporter disorders
name: Intestinal and renal hexose transport and its disorders
rationale: All members describe glucose, galactose and fructose transport and absorption and SLC2/SLC5 transporter defects, distinguishing it from galactose catabolism, urate and amino acid transport confusables.

core: Protein quality control and ubiquitin-dependent degradation
name: Ubiquitin-dependent quality control of misfolded proteins and ERAD
rationale: Members cover misfolded-protein responses, E3 ligases, DUBs, N-/C-degron and proteasomal degradation and ERAD regulation, unlike confusables on ubiquitin chain types, ribosome-associated QC, stress granules or aggrephagy.

name: Skin appendage development with melanocyte and hair-cycle regulation
rationale: Members concern hair follicle maturation and anagen, nail and sebaceous gland development, epidermal morphogenesis and melanocyte proliferation/differentiation, unlike confusables on keratinocyte cornification or ectodermal placode formation.

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion organizing excitatory synapse assembly
rationale: Members are synaptic adhesion molecules (neurexins/neuroligins, SALMs, RPTPs) and pre/postsynaptic membrane assembly with PSD-95 and NMDA receptor clustering, unlike confusables involving inhibitory synapse and GABA receptor clustering.

name: Dendritic spine and postsynaptic actin remodelling in synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members concern spine morphogenesis, dendrite arborization, postsynaptic actin organization and structural plasticity/LTD, unlike confusables on reelin, EPHB/Rho GTPase or BDNF-TRKB signalling.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance
rationale: Members cover microglial proliferation, migration, cytotoxicity and activation together with amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance, with amyloid-beta clearance distinguishing it from microglia/efferocytosis and amyloid fibril confusables.
